diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-1 Cylinder block
diagrams.description: Isometric technical drawing of the L28 monoblock cast cylinder block showing deep skirt structure and 7-bearing support locations.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Monoblock deep-skirt design with 7 main bearing support journals.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-2 Crankshaft
diagrams.description: Forged steel 7-bearing crankshaft with integrated balance counterweights.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Main bearings lubricated via oil holes intersecting main oil gallery.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-3 Piston and connecting rod
diagrams.description: Exploded view of piston assembly, rings, piston pin, connecting rod, and rod bearing shells.
measurements_and_specs: Full floating pin fit in piston
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Cast aluminum slipper-skirt with invar-strut; full pressure lubrication from adjacent main journal.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-4 Cylinder head
diagrams.description: Aluminum cylinder head casting with 5 camshaft bearing brackets, valve train assembly, and cylinder head gasket.
measurements_and_specs: Hot press-fitted brass intake and heat resistant steel exhaust valve seats
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Lightweight aluminum alloy head with wedge-shaped combustion chambers.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-5 Camshaft
diagrams.description: Six-cylinder camshaft showing journals, lobes with lubrication holes, and drive sprocket mounting flange.
measurements_and_specs: Oil hole drilled in base circle of each lobe
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Concentric oil passages drilled in front and rear; long-overlap profile to reduce NOx emissions.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-6 Valve mechanism
diagrams.description: Detailed view of intake and exhaust valve train assemblies including rocker arms, pivots, retainers, inner and outer valve springs, valve guides, and valves.
measurements_and_specs: Dual concentric valve springs (inner and outer)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Pivot-type rocker arm actuated directly by camshaft lobes.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-7 Camshaft driving chain
diagrams.description: Front view of timing chain arrangement showing double row roller chain, crankshaft sprocket, camshaft sprocket, tensioner, and guide shoes.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Tension controlled by spring tension and engine oil pressure.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-8 Exhaust and intake manifold
diagrams.description: Cast aluminum intake manifold and dual-exhaust cast manifold layout with mounting flanges and hardware.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Connected to exhaust downpipes by flanges to prevent exhaust leaks.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-9 Engine on engine stand
diagrams.description: Engine mounted on overhaul stand using dedicated engine attachment bracket.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Attach to cylinder block using alternator bracket and engine mount bolt holes.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-10 Removing air regulator
diagrams.description: Removal of air regulator, connecting hoses, and pipe assembly from intake.
components: Rocker cover to throttle chamber hose
Throttle chamber to regulator hose and pipe

callouts.2: Rocker cover to throttle chamber hose
callouts.4: Throttle chamber to regulator hose and pipe

diagrams.mechanic_notes: Remove parts 1 through 4 as an assembly.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-11 Removing E.G.R. control valve and B.P.T. valve
diagrams.description: Removal of EGR and BPT control valves and heat shield plate.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Disconnect control tube from intake manifold first.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-12 Removing throttle chamber
diagrams.description: Removal of throttle chamber with B.C.D.D. and dashpot.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Remove throttle chamber mounting bolts with hexagon wrench.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-13 Removing fuel pipe assembly
diagrams.description: Removal of EFI fuel rail assembly with injectors, pressure regulator, and cold start valve.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Refer to Section EF for detailed EFI component servicing.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-14 Removing water tube
diagrams.description: Heater housing water tubes removal.
components: Heater housing to thermostat housing tube
Heater housing to water inlet tube

callouts.1: Heater housing to thermostat housing tube
callouts.2: Heater housing to water inlet tube

diagrams.mechanic_notes: Disconnect tubes before thermostat housing removal.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-15 Removing thermostat housing
diagrams.description: Removing thermostat housing with mounted sensors as an assembly.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Remove housing with sensors attached to prevent damage.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-16 Removing hose and sub heat shield plate
diagrams.description: Removal of PCV hose, sub heat shield plate, and EGR tube.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Detach PCV hose and EGR tube fasteners from manifold area.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-17 Removing idler pulley and compressor mounting bracket
diagrams.description: Removal of A/C compressor mounting bracket and belt idler pulley.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Support compressor by hand when removing last upper bolts to prevent falling.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-18 Removing crank pulley
diagrams.description: Using puller ST16540000 to extract crankshaft pulley/damper from crankshaft snout.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Use dedicated puller ST16540000 to avoid damaging pulley damper rubber.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-19 Supporting timing chain
diagrams.description: Timing chain wedge/stopper ST17420001 inserted between chain runs to hold timing position during head removal on car.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Prevents chain tensioner piston from popping out and maintains chain/sprocket timing alignment.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-20 Cylinder head bolt loosening sequence
diagrams.description: Numbered loosening sequence (1 to 14) for cylinder head bolts using special wrench ST10120000.

callouts.1-14: Bolt loosening order (outer to inner cross pattern)

diagrams.mechanic_notes: Follow exact reverse spiral loosening sequence (1 to 14) to prevent cylinder head warpage.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-21 Removing front cover
diagrams.description: Removing engine front timing cover from cylinder block.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Invert engine before removing oil pan and front cover.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-22 Removing chain tensioner and timing chain
diagrams.description: Removal of hydraulic chain tensioner, tensioner spindle, and timing chain guides.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Inspect tensioner shoe and guide surfaces for groove wear.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-23 Removing chain drive sprocket
diagrams.description: Pulling crankshaft timing sprocket, oil thrower, and distributor drive worm gear off front of crankshaft.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Note orientation of oil thrower and worm gear relative to woodruff key.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-24 Removing piston and connecting rod assembly
diagrams.description: Pushing piston and connecting rod assembly out through top of cylinder block.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Extract connecting rod bearings and keep them in cylinder sequence order.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-25 Removing flywheel
diagrams.description: Loosening flywheel bolts while preventing crankshaft rotation.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Flywheel is heavy; take care not to drop it upon removing the last bolt.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-26 Removing rear main bearing cap
diagrams.description: Extracting center and rear main bearing caps using bridge puller KV101041S0.
components: Crankshaft main bearing cap puller KV101041S0

callouts.KV101041S0: Crankshaft Main Bearing Cap Puller KV101041S0

diagrams.mechanic_notes: Keep main bearing caps in strict numbered and directional order.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-27 Removing rear oil seal
diagrams.description: Removing rear crankshaft oil seal retainer from block rear face.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Inspect crankshaft sealing surface for grooving.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-28 Removing baffle plate and net
diagrams.description: Removing crankcase oil baffle plate and cylinder block net.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Ensure cylinder block net is completely clear of debris during cleaning.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-29 Removing piston ring
diagrams.description: Using ring expander tool to remove compression and oil rings from piston grooves.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Avoid excessive spreading to prevent permanent deformation or fracture.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-30 Removing piston pin
diagrams.description: Pressing piston pin from connecting rod small end on press fixture ST13030001.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Piston pin is an interference press-fit in connecting rod small end.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-31 Removing rocker arm
diagrams.description: Depressing valve spring to slip rocker arm free from pivot ball and valve stem tip.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Do not misplace small rocker guides seated on valve stem tips.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-32 Removing camshaft
diagrams.description: Sliding camshaft axially forward out of five cylinder head bearing towers.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: CAUTION: Slide out carefully; do not nick or scratch cam lobes or aluminum bearing bores.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-33 Removing valve
diagrams.description: Compressing valve springs with C-clamp valve spring compressor ST12070000 to remove split collets.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Collect split collets carefully as spring is compressed.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-34 Valve components
diagrams.description: Exploded stack of exhaust and intake valve train parts.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Do not misplace spring seat, oil seal, valve collet, or rocker guide. Keep bearing towers intact to maintain bore line.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-35 Checking cylinder head surface
diagrams.description: Checking cylinder head mating deck warpage using a precision straightedge and feeler gauge.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Measure along length, width, and diagonals of head deck surface.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-36 Intake and exhaust valve dimensions
diagrams.description: Dimensional diagram of poppet valve denoting head diameter H, stem diameter D, overall length L, and face angle α.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Reface valve face and stem tip with valve grinder within specifications.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-37 Checking valve stem diameter
diagrams.description: Measuring valve stem diameter with an outside micrometer.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Measure at top, center, and bottom of stem travel zone.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-38 Regrinding valve face
diagrams.description: Grinding poppet valve face on a specialized valve refacing machine.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Replace valve if margin thickness drops to 0.5 mm (0.020 in) or less.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-39 Measuring spring squareness
diagrams.description: Checking valve spring squareness against a machinist square on a flat surface plate.
measurements_and_specs: Outer spring limit S: 2.2 mm (0.087 in)
Inner spring limit S: 1.2 mm (0.047 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Rotate spring along square to find maximum gap S.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-40 Measuring spring tension
diagrams.description: Testing valve spring load at specified compressed lengths on a spring tester.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Replace springs not meeting load specifications at installed and open heights.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-41 Valve guide dimensions
diagrams.description: Dimensional diagrams of intake and exhaust valve guides.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Note difference between intake and exhaust guide snap ring groove / outer step.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-42 Measuring clearance between valve stem and valve guide
diagrams.description: Emergency deflection check of valve head/stem play within the valve guide.
measurements_and_specs: Max allowable deflection: 0.2 mm (0.008 in) at 30 mm (1.18 in) extension
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Deflection should be rocked parallel to the rocker arm sweep direction.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-43 Valve guide hole for service
diagrams.description: Cylinder head valve guide boss machining dimensions for oversize service guide installation.

callouts.a: Service valve guide hole inner diameter

measurements_and_specs: Intake/Exhaust protrusion: 10.4 to 10.6 mm (0.409 to 0.417 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Maintain 10.4 to 10.6 mm installed height above spring seat.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-44 Reaming valve guide
diagrams.description: Hand reaming installed valve guide bore using KV101039S0 reamer set.
measurements_and_specs: Finished bore: 8.000 to 8.018 mm (0.3150 to 0.3157 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Ream after guide is fully pressed into head and cooled.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-45 Correcting valve seat
diagrams.description: Refacing valve seat using seat cutter ST11650001 with pilot arbor centered in guide.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Use newly installed valve guide bore as center axis.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-46 Service valve seat dimensions
diagrams.description: Sectional profile and service insert dimensions for L28 intake and exhaust valve seats.
measurements_and_specs: Intake outer dia: 45.597 to 45.613 mm (1.7952 to 1.7958 in)
Exhaust outer dia: 37.580 to 37.596 mm (1.4795 to 1.4802 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Ensure counterbore depth stop is set accurately to prevent cutting into aluminum head base.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-47 Standard valve seat dimensions
diagrams.description: Standard valve seat cut angles and contact widths for L28 intake and exhaust valves.
measurements_and_specs: Intake seat diameters: 39 mm, 41.6 mm, 43.8 mm, 45 mm
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Use 3-angle cut to position contact width centered on valve face.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-48 Checking camshaft bearing
diagrams.description: Checking camshaft bearing tower internal bore with a cylinder bore/dial indicator gauge.
measurements_and_specs: Bearing ID standard: 48.000 to 48.016 mm (1.8898 to 1.8904 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: If bearing tower is worn beyond limit, replace cylinder head assembly (towers are integral).

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-49 Valve timing diagram
diagrams.description: Polar circular timing diagram depicting intake open/close and exhaust open/close events relative to TDC and BDC.
measurements_and_specs: See timing angle specifications table on EM-12
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Rotation is clockwise; applies to all six cylinders.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-50 Checking camshaft bend
diagrams.description: Camshaft supported in V-blocks at front and rear journals while measuring runout on center journal with dial indicator.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Bend value is 1/2 of Total Indicator Reading (TIR) over one 360-degree rotation.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-51 Checking cylinder block surface
diagrams.description: Checking cylinder block deck flatness using precision straightedge and feeler gauge.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Combined head and block deck resurfacing must not exceed 0.20 mm (0.0079 in).

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-52 Measuring cylinder bore diameter
diagrams.description: Measuring cylinder bore internal diameter using a precision dial bore indicator gauge.
measurements_and_specs: Standard bore: 86.000 to 86.050 mm (3.3858 to 3.3878 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Check bore diameter at 3 depth levels in both thrust and axial directions.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-53 Cylinder bore measuring positions
diagrams.description: Diagram of cylinder bore measuring depths (20 mm, 60 mm, 100 mm from top deck) and axes (X thrust vs Y axial).
measurements_and_specs: Depths: 20 mm, 60 mm, 100 mm (0.79 in, 2.36 in, 3.94 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Out-of-round = X - Y; Taper = A - B.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-54 Measuring piston diameter
diagrams.description: Measuring piston outside skirt diameter with an outside micrometer.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Measure at specified skirt height to determine true size A.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-55 Measuring piston skirt diameter
diagrams.description: Location schematic showing the 21 mm height position on the piston skirt for measuring diameter.

callouts.about 21 mm (0.83 in): Measurement point 21 mm from bottom of skirt

measurements_and_specs: about 21 mm (0.83 in) above bottom edge
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Always measure skirt diameter at exactly 21 mm from the bottom edge in thrust direction.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-56 Measuring piston fit in cylinder
diagrams.description: Checking piston-to-bore clearance using 0.04 mm feeler gauge strip attached to spring balance scale.
measurements_and_specs: Extracting pull force: 0.2 to 1.5 kg (0.4 to 3.3 lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Slowly pull feeler gauge straight upward; test at 20°C (68°F).

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-57 Measuring piston ring side clearance
diagrams.description: Measuring side clearance between piston ring and ring land using a feeler gauge.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Measure around entire circumference of groove.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-58 Measuring ring gap
diagrams.description: Checking piston ring end gap in cylinder bore using feeler gauge after squaring ring with inverted piston.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Square ring inside bore using piston crown before taking measurement.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-59 Piston pin fitting
diagrams.description: Manual thumb-push check of piston pin fit in piston bosses at room temperature.
measurements_and_specs: Pin to piston clearance: 0.006 to 0.013 mm (0.0002 to 0.00051 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Pin should be a snug finger-push fit at room temperature (20°C / 68°F).

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-60 Measuring piston pin diameter
diagrams.description: Measuring piston pin outside diameter using micrometer.
measurements_and_specs: OD standard: 20.993 to 20.998 mm (0.8265 to 0.8267 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Measure at center and both ends.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-61 Checking rod alignment
diagrams.description: Checking connecting rod bend and twist on an alignment arbor fixture with feeler feelers.
measurements_and_specs: Bend/torsion limit: 0.05 mm per 100 mm (0.0020 in per 3.94 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Check both bend and twist on dedicated aligner fixture.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-62 Checking big end play
diagrams.description: Measuring connecting rod big end side thrust clearance on crank journal using feeler gauge.
measurements_and_specs: Big end play standard: 0.2 to 0.3 mm (0.008 to 0.012 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Measure between connecting rod thrust cheek and crank journal shoulder.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-63 Crankshaft and journal dimensions
diagrams.description: Crankshaft schematic showing main journal and rod pin diameters, journal widths, and measuring axes.
measurements_and_specs: Main journal dia: 54.942 to 54.955 mm (2.1631 to 2.1636 in)
Crank pin dia: 49.961 to 49.974 mm (1.9670 to 1.9683 in)
Main journal widths: 30.5 mm, 19.5 mm, 27 mm, 19.5 mm
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Out-of-round: X-Y; Taper: A-B. Standard limit < 0.01 mm.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-64 Checking crankshaft bend
diagrams.description: Checking crankshaft runout on V-blocks with a dial indicator resting on center main journal.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Bend is half total dial reading over 360 degree revolution.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-65 Checking crankshaft end play
diagrams.description: Measuring crankshaft axial thrust end play using feeler gauge at center thrust main bearing.
measurements_and_specs: End play standard: 0.05 to 0.18 mm (0.0020 to 0.0071 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Pry crankshaft back and forth and check clearance with feeler gauge at thrust bearing flange.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-66 Pulling out pilot bushing
diagrams.description: Removing transmission pilot bushing from crankshaft tail with puller ST16610001.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Insert collet fingers behind bushing inside crankshaft rear bore.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-67 Press-fitting new pilot bushing
diagrams.description: Pressing new pilot bushing into crankshaft flange to specified protrusion depth.
measurements_and_specs: Protrusion height above flange: 6.5 to 7.0 mm (0.256 to 0.276 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Do not oil pilot bushing; it is oil-impregnated bronze.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-68 Plastigage
diagrams.description: Plastigage wax strip and measurement scale envelope.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Do not rotate crankshaft while plastigage strip is in place.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-69 Measuring bearing clearance
diagrams.description: Comparing compressed plastigage width against scale envelope to read oil clearance.
measurements_and_specs: Torque cap to 4.5 to 5.5 kg-m (33 to 40 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Measure at widest part of squashed wax strip.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-70 Checking bearing crush
diagrams.description: Schematic of bearing shell crush height 'H' protruding above parting face when seated under test weight.
measurements_and_specs: Main bearing crush: 0 to 0.03 mm (0 to 0.0012 in)
Connecting rod crush: 0.015 to 0.045 mm (0.0006 to 0.0018 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Lock one side flush and measure protrusion H at opposite parting face with feeler gauge.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-71 Checking camshaft sprocket runout
diagrams.description: Dial indicator setup measuring runout of camshaft sprocket mounted on camshaft supported on V-blocks.
measurements_and_specs: Runout limit: 0.1 mm (0.004 in) total indicator reading
diagrams.mechanic_notes: If runout exceeds 0.1 mm (0.004 in), replace camshaft sprocket.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-72 Checking camshaft end play
diagrams.description: Measuring camshaft end play with a feeler gauge inserted between locating plate and camshaft journal front shoulder.
measurements_and_specs: Camshaft end play: 0.08 to 0.38 mm (0.0031 to 0.0150 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Check end play clearance using feeler gauge between locating plate and camshaft.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-73 Camshaft locate plate
diagrams.description: Camshaft locate plate showing oblong groove angular range (4° 15') and lower locator notch angle (10°).
diagrams.mechanic_notes: If camshaft sprocket location notch comes off the left end of the oblong groove at TDC compression No. 1, chain stretch is beyond limits.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-74 Adjusting camshaft sprocket location
diagrams.description: Comparison diagram showing camshaft sprocket location holes 1 to 3 and timing marks (1) to (3) before and after adjustment.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: When No. 2 hole is used, No. 2 timing mark must also be used. If chain stretch exceeds No. 3 hole capability, replace chain assembly.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-75 Camshaft drive mechanism
diagrams.description: Exploded view of the timing chain drive system showing sprockets, chain, guides, and tensioner.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Inspect tensioner shoe and chain guides for wear or grooves.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-76 Checking flywheel deviation
diagrams.description: Measuring flywheel clutch friction face runout using a dial indicator mounted on engine block.
measurements_and_specs: Runout limit: 0.15 mm (0.0059 in) total indicator reading
Ring gear heating temp: 180 to 220°C (356 to 428°F)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Replace flywheel if surface runout exceeds 0.15 mm (0.0059 in).

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-77 Oil seal of crankshaft
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional orientation diagram for front cover and rear crankshaft oil seals showing front direction.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Pay attention to mounting direction. Install new seals during engine overhaul.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-78 Applying sealant (Front cover and gasket)
diagrams.description: Front of cylinder block showing sealant application points at front cover gasket corners.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Apply sealant at corners of front cover and cylinder block.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-79 Applying sealant (Main bearing cap and cylinder block)
diagrams.description: Rear main bearing cap showing sealant bead of 20 to 25 mm applied to each side where it mates with cylinder block.
measurements_and_specs: Sealant bead length: 20 to 25 mm (0.79 to 0.98 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Apply sealant along sides of rear main bearing cap across 20 to 25 mm (0.79 to 0.98 in).

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-80 Applying sealant (Cylinder block)
diagrams.description: Oil pan mounting face of cylinder block highlighting four step portions where sealant must be applied.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Apply sealant to step portions at four mating surfaces (block to rear main bearing cap and front cover).

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-81 Installing valve
diagrams.description: Compressing valve springs on cylinder head using Valve Lifter ST12070000 to insert valve collets.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Assemble valve, inner and outer springs, retainer, collets, and rocker guide.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-82 Installing valve spring
diagrams.description: Uneven pitch valve spring showing red painted narrow-pitch side installed toward cylinder head.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Install outer valve spring facing red painted side (narrow pitch) to cylinder head surface.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-83 Installing camshaft locating plate
diagrams.description: Installing camshaft and locating plate into front of cylinder head.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Oblong groove of locating plate must be directed toward front side of engine. Do not damage bearings.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-84 Installing camshaft sprocket
diagrams.description: Tightening camshaft sprocket retaining bolt on front of cylinder head.
measurements_and_specs: Tightening torque: 13 to 15 kg-m (94 to 108 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Tighten sprocket bolt to 13 to 15 kg-m. Check camshaft end play.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-85 Installing rocker arm
diagrams.description: Depressing valve spring with a screwdriver to install rocker arm beneath camshaft lobe.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Press valve spring down using a screwdriver to seat rocker arm on pivot.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-86 Assembling cylinder head
diagrams.description: Assembled cylinder head showing valve train and camshaft rotated so No. 1 is at TDC compression.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Turn camshaft until No. 1 piston is at TDC on its compression stroke.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-87 Installing piston pin
diagrams.description: Pressing piston pin into connecting rod and piston using Pin Press Stand ST13030001.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Apply engine oil to pin and small end of rod. Pressing force must be 0.5 to 1.5 tons.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-88 Assembling piston and connecting rod
diagrams.description: Assembly orientation of piston and connecting rod showing front mark notch and connecting rod oil hole.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Oil jet hole must be directed toward right side of cylinder block; notch on piston head toward front of engine.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-89 Installing piston ring
diagrams.description: Installing top, second, and oil rings onto piston ring lands using ring expander.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Install rings with marked side up. Top ring is chrome-plated; second ring has larger taper.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-90 Main bearings
diagrams.description: Arrangement of #1 through #7 main bearings and bearing caps from front to rear.
measurements_and_specs: Only center bearing (No. 4) is flanged type
diagrams.mechanic_notes: All inter-bearings (#2, 3, 5, 6) are same type. Front (#1) and rear (#7) are same type. Upper and lower bearings are interchangeable.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-91 Torque sequence of cap bolts
diagrams.description: Tightening sequence (1 to 14) for the 7 main bearing caps, starting from center bearing #4 and alternating outwards.
measurements_and_specs: Tightening torque: 4.5 to 5.5 kg-m (33 to 40 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Tighten in 2 to 3 stages outwardly from center bearing in sequence 1 to 14. Arrow marks point forward.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-92 Checking crankshaft end play
diagrams.description: Checking crankshaft axial end play with a dial indicator positioned at crankshaft nose.
measurements_and_specs: Crankshaft end play: 0.05 to 0.18 mm (0.0020 to 0.0071 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Check that crankshaft end play is 0.05 to 0.18 mm and turns smoothly.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-93 Driving side oil seal
diagrams.description: Driving side oil seals into side slots of rear main bearing cap.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Apply sealant to side oil seals prior to driving them into rear main bearing cap.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-94 Installing rear oil seal
diagrams.description: Driving rear oil seal into block using Rear Oil Seal Drift ST15310000.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Apply lithium grease to sealing lip; coat shaft and periphery with engine oil.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-95 Installing flywheel
diagrams.description: Tightening flywheel fixing bolts on rear crankshaft flange.
measurements_and_specs: Tightening torque: 13 to 15 kg-m (94 to 108 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Tighten flywheel bolts securely to 13 to 15 kg-m.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-96 Installing piston-rod assembly
diagrams.description: Installing piston and connecting rod into cylinder using Piston Ring Compressor EM03470000.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Apply oil to sliding parts; align front notch on piston head toward front of engine.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-97 Piston ring direction
diagrams.description: Orientation of top ring, second ring, and oil ring gaps positioned 180° apart, avoiding thrust and pin directions.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Stagger ring gaps at 180° to each other, avoiding thrust and pin directions.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-98 Installing connecting rod cap
diagrams.description: Torquing connecting rod cap nuts onto connecting rod big end.
measurements_and_specs: Tightening torque: 4.5 to 5.5 kg-m (33 to 40 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Arrange connecting rods and caps so cylinder numbers face in same direction. Torque to 4.5 to 5.5 kg-m.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-99 Checking big end play
diagrams.description: Measuring connecting rod big end side play with feeler gauge between connecting rod thrust shoulder and crankpin web.
measurements_and_specs: Big end play: 0.2 to 0.3 mm (0.008 to 0.012 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Measure big end side play with feeler gauge. Standard is 0.2 to 0.3 mm.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-100 Cylinder head bolts
diagrams.description: Top view of cylinder head identifying positions of long bolts (A) and short bolts (B).
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Ensure type A and type B head bolts are installed in their correct designated positions.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-101 Installing timing chain
diagrams.description: Timing chain routing diagram showing sprocket mating marks and 42 chain links between timing marks.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Align mating marks on timing chain with crankshaft sprocket and camshaft sprocket on the right-hand side. 42 links between marks.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-102 Installing chain tensioner
diagrams.description: Installing chain tensioner assembly into cylinder block with spindle protrusion adjusted to 0 mm.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Adjust protrusion of chain tensioner spindle to 0 mm before installing.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-103 Installing front cover
diagrams.description: Front cover mounted on cylinder block showing timing indicator scale.
measurements_and_specs: Height difference limit: less than 0.15 mm (0.0059 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Check height difference between cylinder block upper face and front cover upper face (must be less than 0.15 mm). Apply sealant as shown in Fig. EM-78.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-104 Front cover bolts
diagrams.description: Front cover bolt positions showing different lengths and sizes.
measurements_and_specs: M8 torque: 1.0 to 1.6 kg-m (7 to 12 ft-lb)
M6 torque: 0.4 to 0.8 kg-m (2.9 to 5.8 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Note that different types of bolts are used. Torque M8 to 1.0-1.6 kg-m, M6 to 0.4-0.8 kg-m.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-105 Installing crankshaft pulley
diagrams.description: Installing crankshaft pulley and water pump on front cover and tightening pulley nut.
measurements_and_specs: Crankshaft pulley nut torque: 12 to 16 kg-m (87 to 116 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Set No. 1 piston at TDC on compression stroke when installing crankshaft pulley and water pump.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-106 Tightening sequence
diagrams.description: Cylinder head bolt tightening sequence diagram showing numbers 1 to 14, using special wrench ST10120000.
measurements_and_specs: Tightening torque: 7.0 to 8.5 kg-m (51 to 61 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Tighten head bolts in sequence from center outward. Remember to tighten two small bolts.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-107 Setting distributor driving spindle
diagrams.description: Aligning punch mark on distributor driving spindle with oil hole on oil pump shaft.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Assemble oil pump and drive spindle, aligning driving spindle punch mark face with oil pump hole.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-108 Installing oil pump
diagrams.description: Inserting oil pump and spindle assembly into bottom of front cover.
measurements_and_specs: Tightening torque: 1.1 to 1.5 kg-m (8 to 11 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Do not forget gasket. Tighten bolts to 1.1 to 1.5 kg-m.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM 109 Setting distributor drive spindle
diagrams.description: Top view of distributor spindle drive slot oriented at 11:25 a.m. position with smaller bow-shape facing front.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Projection on top must be located at 11:25 a.m. position with smaller bow-shape facing toward front.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-110 Adjusting valve clearance
diagrams.description: Adjusting valve clearance at rocker pivot using special Pivot Adjuster ST10640001 and feeler gauge.
measurements_and_specs: Tightening torque: 5.0 to 6.0 kg-m (36 to 43 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: First adjust cold, then re-check hot after warming up engine. Torque lock nut to 5.0-6.0 kg-m.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-111 Location of intake manifold securing bolts
diagrams.description: Locations of long bolts (40 mm / 1.57 in) and short bolts (32 mm / 1.26 in) on intake manifold.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: There are two types of 10M bolts. When installing, do not confuse them.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-112 Installing clutch assembly
diagrams.description: Aligning clutch disc using Clutch Aligning Bar KV30100100 while securing clutch cover to flywheel.
measurements_and_specs: Tightening torque: 1.2 to 2.2 kg-m (9 to 16 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Use Clutch Aligning Bar KV30100100 to center disc. Torque clutch cover bolts to 1.2 to 2.2 kg-m.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-113 Installing compressor
diagrams.description: Exploded view of air conditioning compressor, mounting bracket, idler pulley, and fasteners.

callouts.*: Tightening torque: 4.5 to 5.5 kg-m (33 to 40 ft-lb)

measurements_and_specs: Compressor mounting bolts (*): 4.5 to 5.5 kg-m (33 to 40 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Tighten bolts marked with asterisk to 4.5 to 5.5 kg-m.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-114 Air conditioning compressor belt tension
diagrams.description: Checking A/C compressor belt tension with thumb pressure applied midway between idler pulley and compressor pulley.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Adjust idler pulley bolt so belt deflection is 8 to 12 mm under 10 kg thumb pressure.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EM-115 Fan belt tension
diagrams.description: Checking fan/alternator drive belt deflection with thumb pressure applied midway between pulleys.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Deflection should be held within 8 to 12 mm under 10 kg thumb pressure applied midway between pulleys.

diagrams.caption: Cam lobe height dimension "A"
diagrams.description: Camshaft profile showing total lobe height dimension "A" from base circle to cam peak.
measurements_and_specs: Standard height of cam "A": 40.30 to 40.35 mm (1.5866 to 1.5886 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Measure total cam lobe height across dimension A. Standard specification is 40.30 to 40.35 mm.

diagrams.caption: ST19320000 Oil filter wrench
diagrams.description: Band type oil filter wrench tool.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Used to remove spin-on oil filter.

diagrams.caption: ST05340001 Engine attachment
diagrams.description: Engine mounting adapter plate with mounting bolts for attaching block to overhaul stand.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Bolts to right-hand side of cylinder block to mount engine onto engine stand.

diagrams.caption: ST0501S000 Engine stand assembly
diagrams.description: Mobile engine stand assembly with rolling caster base and rotating mount head.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Used to support engine during overhaul.

diagrams.caption: ST16540000 Puller crank pulley
diagrams.description: Two-bolt mechanical puller crossbar for removing crankshaft pulley / damper.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Used to pull crankshaft pulley from crankshaft nose.

diagrams.caption: ST17420001 Chain stopper
diagrams.description: Wedge-shaped chain stopper block to retain timing chain when cylinder head is removed.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Holds timing chain in position to prevent tensioner spindle from extending.

diagrams.caption: ST10120000 Cylinder head bolt wrench
diagrams.description: Deep reach socket adapter wrench for tightening cylinder head bolts.
components: Cylinder head bolt wrench socket tool
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Special deep socket extension for reaching cylinder head bolts between rocker gear.

diagrams.caption: KV101041S0 Crankshaft main bearing cap puller
diagrams.description: Bridge-type puller with threaded adapters for extracting main bearing caps from cylinder block.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Pulls main bearing caps evenly without distorting block dowels.

diagrams.caption: ST13030001 Piston pin press stand
diagrams.description: Support fixture and pilot drift for pressing piston pins into connecting rods under hydraulic press.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Used with press (0.5 to 1.5 tons) for installing piston pins.

diagrams.caption: ST12070000 Valve lifter
diagrams.description: C-frame valve spring compressor tool for removing and installing valve springs and collets.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Compresses inner and outer valve springs to install or remove collets.

diagrams.caption: KV101039S0 Valve guide reamer set
diagrams.description: Valve guide reamers and drift set including 12.2 mm reamer, 8.0 mm reamer, and replacement drift.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Used for reaming valve guide holes in cylinder head and finishing valve guide bore.

diagrams.caption: ST11650001 Cutter set valve seat
diagrams.description: Case containing valve seat cutter set for refacing intake and exhaust valve seats.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Used for refacing valve seats to 45 degree angle.

diagrams.caption: ST16610001 Pilot bushing puller
diagrams.description: Internal expanding collet puller for removing pilot bushing from rear of crankshaft.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Used to pull pilot bushing out of crankshaft flange.

diagrams.caption: ST15310000 Crankshaft rear oil seal drift
diagrams.description: Knurled circular drift tool for installing crankshaft rear main oil seal.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Drives rear crankshaft oil seal squarely into position.

diagrams.caption: EM03470000 Piston ring compressor
diagrams.description: Adjustable spring band piston ring compressor with friction brake lock.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Compresses piston rings flush with skirt during installation into cylinder bore.

diagrams.caption: ST10640001 Pivot adjuster
diagrams.description: Curved offset open wrench for adjusting valve rocker pivots and tightening lock nuts.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Specially shaped to clear valve train components when setting valve lash.

diagrams.caption: KV30100100 Clutch aligning bar
diagrams.description: Stepped clutch alignment arbor matching transmission input shaft splines and pilot bushing bore.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Centers clutch friction disc relative to flywheel pilot bushing during pressure plate torquing.

troubleshooting.probable_cause: Worn and/or broken tension adjusting mechanism
Insufficient clearance between valve stem and guide
Seized or damage of valve stem

troubleshooting.corrective_action: Clean crankcase, replace oil and oil filter element.

troubleshooting.probable_cause: Wrong assembly of piston with connecting rod
